title: Queue
description: What is new or changed since your last visit, and what is waiting on you.

loadFailed.title: The queue could not be loaded.
loadFailed.network: The backend did not answer. Your marker was not moved. Reload to try again; if it keeps failing, check that the backend is reachable.
loadFailed.forbidden: Your account may not open the queue. Ask an administrator for access.
loadFailed.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
loadFailed.server: The backend failed while building the queue. Your marker was not moved. Reload to try again; if it keeps failing, check the backend log.

marker.label: Comparison
marker.stored: Showing what changed since {time} (your last visit)
marker.first: Showing what changed since {time} (last 24 h — first visit)
marker.override: Showing what changed since {time} (compared with {chip} ago)
marker.advanced: Your marker moved to {time}. The New and Updated labels still compare with the visit before.
marker.keptOverride: Your marker was not moved while a comparison time is chosen.
marker.keptNarrowed: Your marker was not moved because this view is narrowed by a scope, filter or page. Open the unfiltered first page to move it.
marker.keptFailed: Your marker was kept at {marker} because {sources} did not load.
marker.keptFailedNone: Your marker was kept (none is stored yet) because {sources} did not load.
marker.changed: Another session moved your marker to {time}. Reload to compare with it.
marker.changedUnknown: Another session moved your marker. Reload to compare with it.
marker.refused: The server did not move your marker because a source failed to load. It stays where it was.
marker.postFailed: Your marker could not be moved. It stays where it was; the labels below are unaffected. Reload to try again.

sources.label: Sources
sources.heading: Sources
sources.lowerBound: A source failed, so the total is a lower bound.
sources.notApplicable: does not apply to this scope or severity filter
sources.failed: failed to load. Its rows are missing and the total below is a lower bound. Reload; if it keeps failing, check the backend log.
sources.forbiddenUnknown: not shown. Your account lacks the permission to read it.

notCollected.NO_CONSOLE: not collected. No QRadar console is configured. Add one under Administration.
notCollected.CONSOLE_UNCOLLECTED: not collected. No console has completed a collection yet. It is collected on the console's cadence.
notCollected.default: not collected. Nothing was read, so nothing is claimed about it.

stale.COLLECTION_STALE: stale. Last collected {age} ago ({time}). The rows are from that run.
stale.COLLECTION_FAILING: stale. The latest collection failed. The rows are from the last good run ({time}, {age} ago).
stale.default: stale. The rows are from the last collection ({time}, {age} ago).

sources.staleNoTime: stale. The rows are from the last collection; its time is not known.

partial.OWNER_UNMAPPED: owner mapping unavailable. This account has no QRadar username, so offenses cannot be matched to it. Mine shows no offenses.
partial.ALERT_LINK_FAILED: counted in full, but the alert link could not be looked up. Anomaly rows may be missing their alert chip.
partial.ALERTS_NOT_READABLE: counted in full. Alert chips are not shown because this account lacks the read:alerts permission.
partial.default: partly read. Some of it is missing.

capped: The queue holds more than 1000 rows. Narrow it with a filter.

empty.all: Nothing is waiting. Every source you may read loaded at {time}.
empty.scope: Nothing is waiting in {scope}. Every source you may read loaded at {time}.
empty.newOnly: Nothing new or updated in {scope} since {time}.
empty.filtered: Nothing waiting matches these filters. Use Clear filters above to widen the view.
empty.unread: No rows are shown, and that is not a clean result: {sources} could not be read in full. See the sources above.
